D.6 DISPOSAL OF WASTE AND SURPLUS MATERIALS

Sites for disposal of wastes or surplus materials may need to be located,
and methods of disposal resolved, for such materials as :

{a) excavated soil and rock,

{b) dredged materials,

{c) building debris and construction wastes,
(d) liquid wastes.

Access to controlled tips and public dumping areas must be determined,
as well as transport requirements and environmental controls.
